description: This file provides shared helper functions and type definitions for reply-history management within plugins, specifically for maintaining per-thread context windows.

methods.name: buildHistoryContext
methods.description: Constructs a history context from given data.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromEntries
methods.description: Creates a history context from a list of entries.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromMap
methods.description: Builds a history context from a map of entries.

methods.name: buildPendingHistoryContextFromMap
methods.description: Builds a pending history context from a map.

methods.name: clearHistoryEntriesIfEnabled
methods.description: Clears history entries if the feature is enabled.

methods.name: evictOldHistoryKeys
methods.description: Removes old keys from the history to manage size.

methods.name: recordPendingHistoryEntry
methods.description: Records a new pending history entry.

methods.name: recordPendingHistoryEntryIfEnabled
methods.description: Records a pending history entry if the feature is enabled.
